info.title: registry.proto
info.description:
The datasource registry: the generic half of the module.

It knows no datasource. Its catalog is what the datasources a deployment
composed have announced about themselves, so a deployment adds one by
composing it — never by changing anything here. A datasource announces
itself and renews; the catalog is what is currently announced, which makes
it what is actually running rather than what someone once wrote down.

get.summary: GetCatalog answers every datasource currently announced.

post.summary: Announce publishes a datasource, or renews it.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
AnnounceRequest is a datasource joining the catalog, or renewing its place
in it. Announcing again replaces what the catalog holds, so a datasource
that changed what it can do says so by announcing it.

get.summary: Version answers which build is serving.

v1AnnounceRequest.description:
AnnounceRequest is a datasource joining the catalog, or renewing its place
in it. Announcing again replaces what the catalog holds, so a datasource
that changed what it can do says so by announcing it.

renewWithinSeconds.description:
renew_within_seconds is how long this announcement stands. A datasource
that has not renewed within it leaves the catalog, so a catalog never
advertises something that stopped running.

v1AnnounceResponse.description: AnnounceResponse tells the datasource when to announce again.

name.description: name is the datasource's stable identifier within the deployment.

title.description: title is a short human label.

kinds.description: kinds are whatever the datasource says it can reach.

requiresCredential.description: requires_credential reports whether a read needs one.

streams.description: streams reports whether items arrive as a stream.

address.description:
address is where a consumer reaches this datasource's own API. The
module publishes no single interface, so a consumer dials the
datasource directly and speaks whatever the datasource speaks.

v1Datasource.description:
Datasource is a datasource as it describes itself. Every field is the
datasource's own answer: the registry neither interprets nor validates
them, because a registry that understood them would be a registry that has
to change when a new kind of datasource arrives.

datasources.description: datasources are what the deployment composed and what is running.

v1GetCatalogResponse.description:
GetCatalogResponse is the catalog: every datasource currently announced, in
name order so two reads of an unchanged catalog read the same.

version.description: version is the service version codefly stamped into this build.

v1VersionResponse.description: VersionResponse carries the serving build's version.
